{
    "content": "<p>The following can be used to disable throttling on a specific list (must be run\nas an account with enough priv.):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-powershell\">$web = Get-SPWeb &quot;http://whateverWeb&quot;;\n$list = $web.Lists[&quot;List Title&quot;];\n$list.enablethrottling = $false;\n$list.update();\n</code></pre>\n",
